title: cc-docker stack module
description: Schema for stack/<name>/module.yml — consumed by cc-assemble (toolchain/assemble/assemble.py).

name.description: Module name; must match the stack/<name> directory and the modules: entry.

version.description: Toolchain version; drives the module image tag stack/<name>:<version>.

build_deps.description: Extra apt packages beyond base, needed only in the staging build.

runtime_deps.description: apt packages the copied artifact needs in the final image.

artifacts.description: Absolute directories the assembler COPY --from's into the final image.

env.description: Env re-declared in the final image after COPY. PATH must be prepend-form: "<dirs>:${PATH}".
